systems.name: MuleSoft IDP (Intelligent Document Processing)
systems.authDetail: OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials via Anypoint Connected App. Scope: leave EMPTY (permissions controlled by Connected App scopes — NOT 'urn:anypoint:idp'). Token endpoint: https://anypoint.mulesoft.com/accounts/api/v2/oauth2/token. Connected App permission required: 'Execute Published Actions'.
systems.rateLimits: Min polling interval 10s per IDP quota docs. Per-submission limit: 10MB / 50 pages. P50 latency 7.6s, P99 13.4s for extraction.
knownQuirks: Preferred connector is MuleSoft Forge IDP Connector (io.github.mulesoft-forge:mule-idp-connector v1.0.6) — available on Maven Central (NOT Anypoint Exchange — must add mavenCentral() repo to pom.xml). Requires Mule 4.6+
Fallback path is HTTP connector against IDP REST API directly — use only if Forge connector is not viable. Base URL: https://idp-rt.{region}.anypoint.mulesoft.com/api/v1/

Async submit/poll pattern — POST submit returns execution ID, GET poll on /executions/{id}/v2 (note /v2 suffix). Status values: ACKNOWLEDGED | IN_PROGRESS | RESULTS_PENDING | SUCCEEDED | FAILED | PARTIAL_SUCCESS | MANUAL_VALIDATION_REQUIRED
Hard limits per submission: 10MB and 50 pages — must verify HS-105, 299A, 299B, HS-118 documents fit
Results returned in pages[].fields[] — DataWeave mapping must handle multi-page results
Manual-review queue is mandatory — all failed extractions (FAILED, MANUAL_VALIDATION_REQUIRED) must route to a human-review channel
prerequisites: Confirmation that IDP is the chosen extractor vs. an alternative (Venkat B 2026-04-15: 'I don't think we would be using an LLM, but I'll try to understand once we have a couple of samples')
Representative samples of HS-105, 299A, 299B, HS-118 provided by Peerless for IDP action training

IDP action published and trained on the four contract templates; action ID + action version ID captured

Validation rule library encoded as deterministic checks: signatures legible, dates are Fridays, 299A and 299B contract prices match, yes/no boxes not both ticked, permit-required flag is one value, 100% deposit except Wisconsin 99%
Anypoint org ID captured for configuration
MuleSoft Anypoint subscription confirmed to include IDP
